mapper.select: SELECT * FROM brick_flow_run WHERE flow_id = #{flowId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, flow_id AS flowId, status, triggered_by AS triggeredBy, run_type AS runType, duration_ms AS durationMs, error_msg AS errorMsg, override_base_url AS overrideBaseUrl, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, suite_run_id AS suiteRunId, batch_id AS batchId, remark, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime FROM brick_flow_run WHERE flow_id = #{flowId} AND status = #{status} AND start_time >= #{startDate} AND start_time <= #{endDate} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE brick_flow_run SET status = #{status}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, end_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE brick_flow_run SET batch_id = #{batchId} WHERE id = #{id}
